_about: SANITISED SAMPLE. Fictional candidate (Alex Rivera) so the Apply-mode Selector runs out of the box without anyone's real resume. Same shape as the private resumes.json: six flavours keyed to archetypes.json, each one the same body text under a different title and summary. Copy to resumes.json and replace with your own.

genai.label: Senior Generative AI Engineer
genai.summary: Generative AI Engineer with 9+ years of experience shipping LLM and retrieval systems to production. Focused on RAG architecture, grounding, and fine-tuning open-weight models.
genai.text:
Alex Rivera
Senior Generative AI Engineer
Phone: 555-0100   |   Email: alex.rivera@example.com   |   LinkedIn:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Generative AI Engineer with 9+ years of experience shipping LLM and retrieval systems to production. Focused on RAG architecture, grounding, and fine-tuning open-weight models.

Machine Learning Engineer with 9+ years of experience turning data systems
into production services. Works across LLM application development, retrieval
systems, and classical ML, with a focus on getting models from prototype into
reliable production deployment.

  Technology Stack

  Generative AI &   GPT-class models, LangChain, LlamaIndex, BERT
  LLMs

  LLM Strategy &    RAG, hybrid search, quantization, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT
  Optimization

  ML & Deep         PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-learn,
  Learning          Pandas, NumPy

  Vector & Data     Chroma, FAISS, pgvector, Postgres
  Storage

  MLOps &           MLflow, Weights & Biases, Pytest, Prometheus
  Observability

  Inference &       FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
  Deployment

  Data Engineering  PySpark, Kafka, SQL, ETL pipeline design

  Cloud Platforms   AWS (SageMaker), Azure Machine Learning

  Languages         Python, Go, SQL

  Professional Experience

  Northwind Data, Remote                          June 2021 - Present

  Senior Machine Learning Engineer

-   Built retrieval-augmented generation systems over enterprise document
    sets, combining vector and keyword retrieval to reduce ungrounded answers.

-   Fine-tuned open-weight language models using LoRA and QLoRA to adapt them
    to domain-specific vocabulary.

-   Developed asynchronous inference APIs with FastAPI, packaged in Docker and
    deployed on Kubernetes.

-   Reduced model memory footprint through quantization, cutting serving cost
    for a production recommendation service.

-   Governed the model lifecycle with MLflow, tracking experiments and
    versioning models from research through to production.

-   Automated the deployment pipeline with GitHub Actions, adding evaluation
    gates that run before every release.

  Corvid Analytics, Austin TX                     Mar 2017 - May 2021

  Machine Learning Engineer

-   Trained and tuned gradient-boosted models for tabular prediction, improving
    holdout AUC by 12% over the previous baseline.

-   Built ETL pipelines in Python and PySpark processing several terabytes of
    event data per week.

-   Deployed scikit-learn models as serverless endpoints, providing a
    cost-effective inference layer for low-volume predictions.

-   Applied PCA and t-SNE to high-dimensional feature spaces to help analysts
    interpret model behaviour.

  Meridian Systems, Austin TX                     Aug 2015 - Feb 2017

  Data Engineer

-   Designed ETL workflows with Python and Airflow feeding a cloud data lake.

-   Built REST APIs in Flask to expose stored datasets to internal consumers.

-   Wrote validation scripts that profiled incoming data and flagged schema
    drift before it reached downstream models.

  Certifications

-   AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty

  Education

-   B.S. in Computer Science
